messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy in change window (02:00 UTC). Starting staged rollout: api v3.2.0 -> runtime v2.8.1; console migration toggle; router header-swap. Preflight checks starting now.

maria: Heads-up — api adds header 'X-Model-Variant'. Router must remap to runtime routing key or we'll see 400s.

tom: Can we pin runtime to v2.8.1 for the whole rollout? The last canary had the kv-eviction tweak that affected long-chat sessions.

nora: Console migration needs the feature-flag toggle. I'll keep the UI toggle off until router confirms mapping. Otherwise console will render empty nav.

kevin: @deploy-bot please pin router to commit abc123 for this wave. Rollback triggers: p50 latency > 120ms sustained, or error rate spike. Agree?

deploy-bot: Action: pin router -> abc123; pin runtime -> v2.8.1; pin api -> v3.2.0. Canary plan: 5% US-east -> 10% global -> 100% over 20m if green.

maria: Smoke test command: ```bash
curl -I -H 'X-Model-Variant: llama-2' https://api.redwood.internal/health
``` Expect HTTP/1.1 200 and header `X-Route: runtime-v2` in responses.

tom: Quick logging change: enable router debug headers for canary only — set env ROUTER_DEBUG=true on abc123.

nora: Release notes posted: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REL-3212 — I'll update the console changelog. Abort criteria: any 4xx surge > 1% in canary.

kevin: Rollback criteria final: p50 > 120ms OR combined 4xx+5xx > 2% for 5m OR console top-level routes fail to load.

maria: Ack. I'll be on-call and will page SRE if alerts fire. tagging @sre-oncall :eyes:

sre-bot: oncall: @jess-alvarez notified.

tom: :thumbsup: all set from runtime side.

nora: Holding feature-flag until router confirms remap. Will flip when deploybot reports canary green. :white_check_mark:
